question: When does a population-dynamics model add predictive value over information-set-matched simple baselines, and when does an individual's own source state carry information beyond the population?

GSE326622.reason: individual = model arm with one animal per time; holding out an arm is not an individual-level task

GSE204777.reason: samples are pooled wounds multiplexed by time and position; no individual-level units

GSE132188.reason: one pooled sample per embryonic stage

GSE122662.reason: conditions, not individuals; confirm at probe

GSE140802.reason: wells/populations, not individuals; confirm at probe

GSE112294.reason: pooled embryos per stage; confirm at probe

clock.note: Sensitivity jobs rerun missing-time and leave-individual tasks with the log-days clock for the listed methods.

T-SRC.design: leave-two-out: held and substitute individuals are both excluded from fitting

T-K.methods_rationale: The count curve asks how error changes with the number of training individuals; one flow variant plus three baselines answers it. Exact minibatch OT is CPU-bound (about 26 s per 1,000 steps) and would add about 20 GPU-hours per large dataset without informing the curve.
T-K.design: Nested training subsets per (held individual, repeat); unit steps k=1..6 allow the frozen plateau criterion (k to k+1, two consecutive intervals containing zero) to be applied literally; 8, 12 and 16 describe the upper range.

flow_defaults.sb_note: Schrodinger-bridge noise per coordinate = sb_sigma_scale x within-segment standard deviation; epsilon = 2 sigma^2 with epsilon scaling; probability-flow ODE (RK4) at prediction.

evaluation.energy_scale_note: Energy is the squared E-statistic (V-statistic). log(1.2) is a 1.2-fold error ratio: 20% increase or 16.7% reduction in energy; corresponding square-root changes are 9.5% increase or 8.7% reduction.

analysis.meta: REML random effects with modified Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman interval
analysis.ranks: Friedman with Nemenyi critical difference over datasets

count_curve.interval: percentile bootstrap over held individuals and paired seed/repeat cells (2,000 draws); conditional because training folds overlap
count_curve.plateau: two consecutive unit-step marginal-improvement intervals containing zero; only with matching evaluation/seeds/budget, at least 3 stochastic seeds per cell, nested subsets, and differences not unresolved at seed scale
count_curve.scope: k is the number of dynamics-training individuals conditional on a common representation fitted on all non-held individuals; not total required donor count

analysis.moderators_note: Task-level log ratios; OLS with dataset-clustered errors and t(G-1); descriptive below 10 datasets.

stage_gate.stage_b_requires: reviewed Stage-A probe and contract reports plus user approval

not_claims: Seeds, cell draws and integration settings are computational sensitivity, not biological replication.
Healthy acute wounds and developmental time courses do not establish diabetic-foot-ulcer prognosis.
A method ranking is stated only through the pre-specified cross-dataset analysis.

datasets_excluded.GSE142471: two time points and different mice at each time: no missing-time or individual-level task is possible
